entities.summary: Piyush Pandey was an Indian advertising professional and the Chief Creative Officer Worldwide (2019) and Executive Chairman India of Ogilvy. He was the recipient of the LIA Legend Award in 2024, and the Padma Shri in 2016. Pandey is also credited with shaping a distinct indigenous influence on Indian advertising that was earlier under the influence of western advertising and ideas.
